The mediation shall be held in Escambia County, Alabama. If, however, the dispute cannot be resolved by mediation, either party may bring an action in the Poarch Band of Creek Indians Tribal Court. For this purpose, Seller specifically consents to jurisdiction on PBCI Reservation.
